title: The VAPIX Edge storage API, enabling the escalation of user privileges by circumventing filesystem isolation, granting…
description: CVE-2026-14543 is a vulnerability in the VAPIX Edge storage API that allows privilege escalation by bypassing filesystem isolation. Exploitation requires authentication with an admin-privileged service account. The flaw grants unauthorized access to protected system resources but does not impact integrity or availability. The vulnerability has a low CVSS score of 3.9 and no known exploits in the wild.
